title: Wayfare Pass All Access Annual Benefit Figures on Wayfare Bikes and Scooters Plans
content:
Riders holding a Wayfare Pass All Access Annual membership in trial, active or pending cancellation status receive classic bike minutes on their Wayfare Bikes and Scooters plan free of charge on top of the plan's included minutes, and on some plans a waived unlock fee. The figures differ by bike plan.

## Benefit figures by bike plan

| Bike plan | Classic minutes per ride free of charge for such members, on top of the plan's included minutes | Unlock fee waived for such members | Order in which the minutes are used |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Bikes Pay As You Ride | 30 | Yes | plan's included minutes first, Pass minutes after them |
| Wayfare Bikes Day Pass | 30 | No | plan's included minutes first, Pass minutes after them |
| Wayfare Bikes Monthly Pass | 0 | No | plan's included minutes first, Pass minutes after them |
| Wayfare Bikes Access Annual | 0 | No | plan's included minutes first, Pass minutes after them |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual | 0 | No | plan's included minutes first, Pass minutes after them |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual Plus | 0 | No | plan's included minutes first, Pass minutes after them |

## Notes

- The free minutes apply per classic bike ride.
- The unlock fee waiver is shown as Yes only for Pay As You Ride; on every other plan it is No.
- When a plan allowance and the Wayfare Pass benefit both apply to one ride, the plan's included minutes are used first and the Pass minutes after them.
- Monthly Pass, Access Annual, Annual and Annual Plus show 0 Pass minutes.

## Illustration (hypothetical ride)

On a bike plan whose figure in this table is 30, with a hypothetical plan allowance of 20 included classic minutes, a classic ride of 65 minutes by such a member uses the 20 plan minutes first, then the 30 Pass minutes, leaving 15 minutes outside both allowances.
